notes: This crate has NO GPUI dependency. acp-map-update.ts turns agent session updates into UI message chunks (types from the `ai` and `@agentclientprotocol/sdk` npm packages): model both sides as serde enums/structs or serde_json::Value with the exact JSON shapes and field names. acp-permission.ts is a zustand store with a queue of permission prompts: port it as a struct with methods. Files that import src/shared/risky-tools.ts: that module is being ported by someone else into another crate right now, so do not depend on it; take the risky-tool decision as a function argument or trait where it is needed and say so in a comment.
